title: XCOPA: A Multilingual Dataset for Causal Commonsense Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accuracy of state-of-the-art multilingual models (MBERT, XLM-R, USE) on the XCOPA dataset across 11 typologically diverse languages to measure performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages.

Assessing model performance on commonsense reasoning scenarios that have been translated and culturally adapted (e.g., substituting concepts like 'bowling ball' with culturally relevant items) to mitigate and measure Anglo-centric bias.
